data.limitations: Ready applies only to requested configuration observations. This is not end-to-end workload readiness. Unrequested surge checks and unobserved evidence are not inferred. No mutations or automatic remediation are performed.

notes: Add --include-surge-protection for capacity-admin reads. Enabled settings alone and partial/forbidden scans stay unknown. --strict preserves stdout but exits non-zero for non-ready checks and adds shared recovery guidance to error.hint. nextSteps.kind distinguishes inspection, review, and remediation: concrete remediation commands are --readonly --dry-run previews requiring approval for the actual change; missingInputs/commandTemplate do not invent runnable arguments. See remediation-hints.
